summary: Lost female hiker on Mt Flora off Berthoud Pass
notes: Mt Flora on Clear Creek/Grand county line; ART mission 2021-012. Outcome re-coded from rescued-uninjured to assist: log does not state the subject's final outcome. MERGE (2026-09-12): same incident as the snowbrains GCSAR account — 20-year-old Colorado Springs woman snowshoeing with her Husky-type dog, became disoriented on top of an avalanche zone between Mines Peak and Mount Flora; abandoned her snowshoes/poles, descended an avalanche chute through waist-deep snow, reached a US Hwy 40 switchback where a stranger picked her up and returned her to the top of the pass where SAR teams were about to depart; dressed in yoga pants, sports bra, and a light jacket. GCSAR responded to four calls that Saturday (15 total in Jan-Feb 2021).
